answer.reason: The Esther verses give Ahasuerus several defining deeds beyond what the summary states.

clauses.english: banished Vashti from his presence after she refused to come at his command
clauses.quote: the king did according to the word of Memucan

clauses.english: made Esther queen instead of Vashti
clauses.quote: made her queen instead of Vashti

clauses.english: gave Haman his ring, and a decree was sent out to destroy all the Jews
clauses.quote: the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman

doubts: EZR 4:6 (an accusation written to him against Judah) was left out as a minor detail, and its identification with the king of Esther is taken from the record's disambiguation.
Later deeds such as granting the Jews leave to defend themselves (EST 8:11) were left out to keep the line short.
